title: Search Gmail with AI: find the email you remember
h1: find gmail messages from a half-remembered detail
description: Ask a bot to find Gmail messages by sender, date, label or attachment. Learn how to get complete results without changing your inbox.
answer: tell a bot what you remember about an email and it can search gmail by sender, subject, date or label, then bring the matching messages into your chat. it only looks; it does not mark mail read or move it. a search can span several pages, and some message details can fail to load, so an incomplete result is not proof the email is missing.
og_line: the message behind the detail you remember.
what:
you can ask for something as ordinary as "the hotel confirmation that arrived before the conference". the bot turns that into gmail search terms and returns subjects, senders and dates you can recognise. labels can narrow the search further; selecting several label ids means a message must have all of them.

a quick search brings back the subject, sender and date. to answer something about what an email says, the bot opens the full message.
uses: recover the delivery confirmation with the tracking reference you forgot to save
collect correspondence with a venue during the month you arranged an event
find unread messages carrying attachments under a specific project label
check which booking emails are in spam or trash as well as the inbox

routine.message: each tuesday at 8, search my personal gmail for hotel and train confirmations received in the last seven days. fetch all result pages and read the matched messages before listing the trip dates and booking references here. flag any message whose details could not be loaded. never change labels, mark messages read or send mail.
routine.needs: personal gmail connected with read only access
routine.output:
travel mail found

alder row inn: check-in friday; reference ar-482.
westmere rail: outbound saturday; reference wr-716.
all result pages checked; no message-detail failures reported.

steps: choose the intended gmail account in **Connected apps** and give the searching bot **read only** access.
describe a known email using its sender and an approximate date; ask for the matching subject so you can recognise it.
request the remaining result pages and full message content when a reference or date needs checking.
schedule the search once it finds the right kind of mail, then inspect the next runs on the routine card and use **Edit** if the timing needs changing.
watch: now and then gmail fails to load an email in the results. the bot should tell you when that happens instead of treating the list as complete.
big searches come back in pages of up to 500 emails; the bot should go through every page.
spam and trash are only included when requested; a missing inbox result may still exist there.
on your own computer the routine doesn't run while it sleeps or the app is closed; a run missed by less than 12 hours runs once when you're back. dusk cloud runs it on time.

faq.q: can it find an email if i do not know the subject?
faq.a: give it a sender, a date window or a phrase you remember. the bot can combine gmail search operators instead of needing an exact subject.

faq.q: will opening search results mark them as read?
faq.a: this action retrieves messages without changing their labels. marking them read would need a separate change action.

faq.q: why did the search show a sender but no email body?
faq.a: a quick search only brings back the subject, sender and date. ask it to open the full email.
